title.narrative: PIMS-9957 Pacific priorities for ecosystem management and NBSAP implementation

description.narrative: The objective of this GBFF PPG, developed by the UNDP Multi Country Office in Fiji, is to develop the project concept into a full project: Responding to Pacific priorities for ecosystem management and NBSAP implementation through strengthening capacities for effective planning and monitoring of ecosystems. As described in the project concept (PPG Request), this project aims to enhance sustainable management of marine and terrestrial ecosystems through strengthened planning, financing, monitoring and inclusive local community participation in Fiji, Nauru and Tonga (Project Objective). It intends to do so by assisting countries these three Pacific Island countries with shared challenges in communicating the need for, and value of, biodiversity and specific areas for improved ecosystem management through the following three components:Component 1: Promoting harmonized national policy, governance, and planning for integrating biodiversity considerations into sustainable landscape and seascape management in Fiji, Nauru and Tonga.Component 2: Leveraging financial solutions and capacities for mainstreaming and monitoring biodiversity in landscapes and seascapes in Fiji, Nauru and Tonga. Component 3: Enhancing knowledge management and awareness to promote transparency, transformative change and compliance
